batches.name: Project Setup & Domain Layer
batches.rationale: Initial module structure and JPA entities required for all other tasks

tasks.title: Module Initialization & POM
tasks.prompt: Create the directory 'apps/02-feedback-roadmap'. Add a pom.xml that uses 'saas-os-parent' as parent and depends on 'saas-os-core'. Update the root pom.xml to include this new module. Use Java 21.

tasks.title: JPA Entities & Flyway Migration
tasks.prompt: Implement JPA entities for Board, Post, Vote, Comment, and StatusHistory. All entities must be linked to the 'Tenant' model from 'saas-os-core'. Create a Flyway migration file V1__feedback_schema.sql in 'apps/02-feedback-roadmap/src/main/resources/db/migration'.

batches.name: Repository & Service Layer
batches.rationale: Data access and core business logic for the application

tasks.title: Repositories & Base Services
tasks.prompt: Implement Spring Data JPA repositories for all entities created in t2. Create BoardService and PostService with CRUD operations. Ensure tenant isolation using the mechanisms in 'saas-os-core'.

tasks.title: Status Update & Vote Logic
tasks.prompt: Implement business logic for updating post status (including audit history) and handling votes (one per email per post). Reuse existing Audit or status change mechanisms from 'saas-os-core' if applicable.

tasks.title: Board & Post Controllers (Admin)
tasks.prompt: Implement REST controllers for Board and Post management. Use RBAC and Auth from 'saas-os-core' to restrict access to authenticated tenant users. Include DTO mapping.

tasks.title: Roadmap Management API
tasks.prompt: Implement API for curators to manage the roadmap (ordering posts, setting ETA labels, toggling public visibility).

batches.name: Public API & Notifications
batches.rationale: External facing endpoints and communication logic

tasks.title: Public Feedback Endpoints
tasks.prompt: Implement public endpoints for board list, post list, post submission, and voting. These should be accessible by tenant slug. Ensure proper validation.

tasks.title: Voter Notifications (Fan-out)
tasks.prompt: Implement background job or async event listener that emails all voters when a post status changes to 'Completed'. Use the notification service from 'saas-os-core'.

batches.name: AI & Advanced Features
batches.rationale: Integration with AI services for enhanced functionality

tasks.title: AI Smart Deduplication
tasks.prompt: Integrate with 'AiService' from 'saas-os-core' to implement semantic deduplication during post submission. Use similarity search on existing post titles/descriptions.

tasks.title: Weekly PM Digest Job
tasks.prompt: Implement a scheduled task that aggregates top-voted posts and trends for each tenant and sends a weekly digest email to the PM.
